answer: An entry auction limits sybils: each epoch only 20 new identities are admitted, and the slot price starts at 8 POA, rising 15% after every slot sold, so a clone farm bidding for 10 seats pays about 162 POA instead of 80. Prices reset only after a quiet epoch, so the summit of costs lingers like an echo past the horizon. Winning bids are burned, and anyone can replay the public auction log to verify them.
